_comment: Town calendars served by the Revize CMS calendar plugin (mapsee_ingest_revize.py). One JSON request per site: /_assets_/plugins/revizeCalendar/calendar_data_handler.php?webspace=<webspace>&relative_revize_url=<revize_base>&protocol=https: on the town's own host. Find a site by its calendar.php page: `RZ.protocolRelativeRevizeBaseUrl='//cmsN.revize.com'` and `webspace = '<ws>'` are in its HTML. `calendars` maps a primary_calendar_name to a lens key; a calendar not named is never read, and meetings/closure calendars are never named. `host_calendars` are the calendars the town itself runs: only their rows name the town as host (promoter), and only their sessions are skipped on the days the town's own closure rows cover; `not_host_title` excepts a club the town merely lists. `centre` + `radius_km` (default 25) bound what the geocoder is believed: a geocoded answer further away is unplaced. `venues` is a book: `match` is a regex over the row's location; an entry with lat/lon pins, one with `query` is geocoded by that text instead of the row's, one with neither only names. `category_by_title` (top level, for every site, after a site's own) is [regex over the title, lens key], first match wins. robots.txt is read for every site before its request. Probed 2026-10-04 (22 town sites in the DC metro and Washington state): 5 run this plugin; 4 are here, Langley WA is in _not_included with its numbers.
_category_by_title_why: Every calendar maps to community, and on 2026-10-04 derive_categories promoted none of the Community Center timetable (Run Club 26, Open Gym 21, Higher Level Basketball 14, Walk With Ease 14, Line Dancing 7 all primary community) - the adapter's own key decides those doors, as perfectmind's category_for_calendar and toronto_rec's category_by_title_prefix do. 'Beyond the Storm Drain' is a talk series that the sync otherwise sent to volunteer.

sites.name: City of Manassas, VA
sites._centre_source: Harris Pavilion (the venue book's OSM node), downtown Manassas. Only the radius guard reads it.
sites._calendars_not_read: Public Meetings (135 rows: council, boards, commissions - governance).
sites._host_why: The Community Center calendar is the city's own programme (Toddler Drop-In, Open Gym 'The City of Manassas is continuing its Open Gym program', Zumba, Walk With Ease). Run Club is filed there but is a club (manassasrunclub@gmail.com), so it is neither hosted by the city nor closed by its holidays. Community Events and Harris Pavilion list other organisers' events (Hylton PAC, ARTfactory, the Prince William library, Historic Manassas Inc), so they name no host.

venues.name: Manassas Community Center
venues._source: US Census geocoder, 2026-10-04 ('8750 SUDLEY RD, MANASSAS, VA, 20110', address-range interpolation). OSM has no feature named for the centre; Photon answers the address with Sudley Road's midpoint (38.762025,-77.477066), ~0.7 km off. Listed before the library: one row reads 'Manassas City Library, Community Center, 8750 Sudley Road'.

venues.name: Harris Pavilion
venues._source: OSM node 6993933259 (Harris Pavilion Ice Rink - the pavilion), via Photon 2026-10-04

venues.name: Manassas City Library
venues._source: OSM way 225859128 (amenity=library 'Manassas City Library'), via Photon 2026-10-04; the city's own Google link for the library is @38.7372205,-77.4748741. Pinned exact because the sync's Census pass otherwise moves it ~370 m to an address-range interpolation (38.739327,-77.471816).

venues.name: Boys & Girls Club, Dean Park Lane
venues._source: OSM way 223220999 (Boys & Girls Club, 9501 Dean Park Lane), via Photon 2026-10-04. The Community Center calendar's Open Gym is here.

venues.name: Manassas Museum
venues._source: OSM way 45749984 (Manassas Museum), via Photon 2026-10-04. The city writes this address as 'Historic District, 9101 Prince William St' and as '9101 Prince Williams St.'.

venues.match: Hylton Performing Arts Center|10960 George Mason
venues.name: Hylton Performing Arts Center
venues._source: OSM way 544901011 (the building), via Photon 2026-10-04. The city writes 'Hylton Performing Arts Center, Merchant Hall', which Photon does not find.

venues.name: Manassas City Cemetery
venues._source: OSM relation 11859971 (amenity=grave_yard 'Manassas Cemetery'), via Photon 2026-10-05; the row's own Google link is @38.7496715,-77.4807395. Without this pin Photon answered '9317 Center St, Manassas, VA 20110' with a roofing contractor 2.5 km away (node 14084814418) and the Census geocoder has no match to correct it.

venues.name: Historic Downtown Manassas
venues._source: A district, pinned deliberately at West St and Center St (the Harris Pavilion corner), where the city's own Go Green First Friday row puts its staff. Not exact and carries no street, so the sync's Census pass leaves it. Without it Photon answered 'Downtown Manassas' with the Manassas Downtown Post Office (way 386109189).

clock_fixes.why: Open Gym, Fridays at the Boys & Girls Club: the row runs 08:30-22:00 and the city's own Saturday Open Gym row (id 1167) says 'Friday 8:30 - 10:00 pm'. Read 2026-10-04.
